data_description.scan_interval: How often to poll the gateway for state updates (5–300 seconds). With Push Webhook active, 60–120 s is sufficient.
data_description.simulation_mode: Run without a real gateway — accepts commands but sends no KNX telegrams. Useful for testing automations.
data_description.allow_diagnostics: Allow the HA diagnostics download to include gateway state, entities, and device details. Passwords are always redacted.
data_description.log_level: Verbosity of integration logs. Use 'debug' for troubleshooting.
data_description.discovery_timeout: How long to wait for KNX group address responses during startup (0.5–10 seconds). Increase on slow networks.
data_description.push_webhook: Optional: receive real-time KNX state updates from an external forwarder instead of relying solely on polling.
data_description.push_ws_url: WebSocket URL of an external KNX forwarder (e.g. ws://192.168.1.100:8765). Leave empty to disable.
data_description.push_auth_method: Authentication method for incoming push HTTP requests: none, token, bearer, or hmac.
data_description.push_token: Shared secret verified on incoming push requests (token / hmac auth).
data_description.push_ws_token: Bearer token sent outbound when connecting to the WebSocket URL.
